stage.label: The real Setu app, embedded
stage.frame: Setu app screen for the current demo scene
stage.emptyBody: The real app appears here. Each scene runs against real services in your own private sandbox.

story.idleBody: Rahima imports fabric from China. Watch Setu answer in Bangla, price the order, find a cash gap, pay through escrow and stop three attacks. Press Start or Auto-play.

scene.failedHint: You can keep going: the next scene does not depend on this one.

phone.title: Demo phone
phone.unavailable: The simulated SMS inbox is not available for this user.

tools.title: Demo tools
tools.liveAiOff: Not available: this server has no model key. Recorded answers are used.
tools.liveAiHint: Off: recorded answers. On: real model calls, {n} left.
tools.liveAiBudget: Live AI is on. Calls left: {n}, then recorded answers.
tools.skipHint: Demo only: ends the Tier 3 pause in this sandbox. Audited.

reset.title: Reset the demo?
reset.body: This rebuilds your private sandbox from the seed data and returns to the first scene. Nothing outside your sandbox changes.

end.title: End your sandbox?
end.body: Your private copy of the data is deleted now. You can start a new sandbox at any time.

presenter.blackout: Screen is blacked out. Press B or click to show it again.

err.expired: Your sandbox has expired. Start a new one to continue.
err.ended: Your sandbox has ended. Start a new one to continue.
err.rate: You are going a little fast. Waiting {s} seconds, then trying once more.
err.capacity: All demo sandboxes are busy right now. Please try again in a minute.
err.required: No sandbox yet. Start a new one to continue.
err.network: We could not reach the demo service. Check that it is running and try again.
err.other: Something went wrong with this scene. You can retry or skip it.

landing.title: Setu guided demo
landing.intro: Setu helps Bangladeshi SMEs that import from Chinese suppliers: landed cost, cash flow, financing and milestone escrow with risk-tiered human approval. Watch the whole story in about four minutes, then explore in your own private sandbox.
landing.sandboxNote: Every step calls the real services. All money is simulated and all people and companies are fictional.
landing.hint: Guided demo plays automatically. Presenter mode adds keyboard shortcuts, notes and a timer.

preflight.title: Pre-flight check
preflight.someFail: Something needs attention before you start.
preflight.replay: AI answers are replayed from recordings
preflight.unreachable: The demo service did not answer. Check that the API is running.
